d:
Celebrate the holiday season with this 20-Minute Christmas Walk at Home Workout! This festive, low-impact cardio workout is a great way to get your steps in, boost your energy, and stay active during the holidays.
Whether you're exercising before the holiday festivities or simply want to fit some movement into your day, grab a little space at home and join me for 20 minutes of Christmas cheer!
Type: Cardio
Level: Intermediate
BPM: 127-130 BPM
Duration: 20 minutes
Steps: 2377 steps
Format: 30 second moves
